_comment: Data-driven signatures: probes + version logic. CVE verdicts are computed only through this file's logic — never hardcoded in Python. Extend for follow-on CVEs (DOM/SOAP/PDO UAF class) without code changes.

vulnerabilities.title: PHP OOM state corruption (longjmp bailout) — unauthenticated RCE

confirmation.safe_note: vulnerable worker may crash & auto-restart; patched returns clean E_ERROR

vulnerabilities.remediation: Upgrade to PHP 8.2.35 / 8.3.36 / 8.4.27 / 8.5.12+. EOL branches (<=8.1): upgrade required or set memory_limit=-1 and session.upload_progress.enabled=Off as partial mitigations.

vulnerabilities.title: PHP persistent-worker stale global state UAF — unauthenticated RCE

confirmation.safe_note: non-destructive reachability proof; silent write absent heap groom

vulnerabilities.remediation: Same versions as CVE-2026-109618. Additionally consider session.upload_progress.enabled=Off defense-in-depth.

patch_floor._comment: Known memory-safety fixes shipped with 8.5.12 beyond the two GHSAs (DOM/SOAP/PDO/Lexbor/Tidy UAF+overflow class). Presented as patch-floor guidance, CVE-pending, NOT inflated to confirmed RCEs.
